name: quiz-item
title: Quiz Item
description: The QuizItem family (RF-4) sharing one Card shell and one set of interaction/accessibility norms: SingleChoiceQuiz, MultiSelectQuiz, TrueFalseQuiz, FillInTheBlankQuiz and ShortAnswerQuiz. Each supports controlled/uncontrolled answer state (onAnswer/onSubmit), an optional informative-feedback slot shown only after submission, and correct/incorrect states carried by icon + text, never color alone. The correct answer is never rendered to the DOM before submission for the auto-graded variants; short answer uses assisted self-assessment against a revealed model answer. Composed from @didact/ui's Card/Button/RadioGroup/Checkbox/Input/Label/Textarea/ToggleGroup -- see packages/core/src/components/quiz-item.tsx for the full rationale.
